people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Mark
people.line: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.

translations.web: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
translations.bsb: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
translations.kjv: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
translations.asv: She that is in Babylon, elect together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Mark my son.
